d: Zero is one of the most powerful ideas in human history, and its roots lie in ancient India. This episode of Tarikh explores the remarkable story of Aryabhata and Brahmagupta, the two great scholars whose work transformed mathematics forever. From the invention of zero as a number to groundbreaking discoveries in astronomy, gravity, and the decimal system, their ideas shaped the modern world. The video traces how Indian mathematics traveled through Baghdad and the Arab world to Europe, influencing science, banking, technology, and global civilization. It also asks an important question:…
